title: update_result
description: Outcome of an agent update, from the updater's `update-result.json`. Sent until acknowledged: the server stores it in the hash-chained audit log, updates the running version, raises a notification for problems and answers `update_result_ack` with the same `result_id` (a `result_id` it already stored is only acknowledged again). Without `result_id` (0.1.13 and older) there is no acknowledgement.

status.description: Updater outcome, for example success, rolled_back, rollback_failed, rollback_pending_reboot, pending_reboot, install_failed, rejected, error, failed, reverted_by_freeze; "unknown" when the file has none. Backend/pops/update_notice.py maps them to notifications; unknown values raise none.

result_id.description: 0.1.14+. Identifies this result; the Windows agent sends the first 32 lower-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of `update-result.json`. Other formats are treated as missing.

running_version.description: 0.1.3+. Version actually running afterwards (after a rollback: the old one). Stored as the device's running version.

rollback.description: How the update was rolled back, for example msi, msi_transaction or msi_repair; "none" when it was not (the updater writes it on success).

agent_state.description: State of the agent service afterwards, for example running, reinstalled or unmanaged (unmanaged is always critical).

reboot_required.description: A restart is needed to finish.
